summary: Replace the untouched football_v2 LLM-prompt behaviour with a hand-written deterministic press/shade controller. Roles resolve each decision by ball ownership: one player presses the ball (go_to_ball/kick_toward toward the opponent goal), the other shades goal-side at 35% back toward our own goal. Guarded the defend_goal_xy dereference so a missing own-goal fix falls back to hold instead of crashi
